devices.note: The Pixel 8 is the phone OBSIDIAN is built and tested on. Nothing here fits the Pixel 8 Pro or the Pixel 8a.

pending.note: The Pixel 9 build is finished, and the whole install has been proved step by step against a stand in for the phone. Nobody has installed it on a real Pixel 9 yet, so it is not offered here. It appears the day that test passes.

The Pixel 7 build is running now, and then it has to be installed on the phone like the others. It is the weakest of the three: its processor cannot tag memory, and Google's updates for it stop in October 2027.
